verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe found a live llms.txt at docs.incident.io (HTTP 200) that indexes a 494-page help center for LLM consumption. Docs evidence also shows per-page agent-oriented markdown exports under the /_llms/ path (help center and API reference), so an agent can be pointed directly at machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation explaining or promoting the llms.txt/agent-docs feature, and independent community corroboration of agents using it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
